description: Kanton Zürich (canton dataset republished on the City of Zürich open data portal) publishes the hazard map showing which areas are endangered by natural hazards in four hazard levels according to federal rules, from the main processes of flooding (rivers and lake) and mass movements (rockfall, permanent and spontaneous landslides, debris flows), plus indicative areas for surface runoff, bank erosion, debris and sediment flows, groundwater rise, sewer backwater and inactive landslides. Coverage: the Canton of Zürich, published on the City of Zürich portal; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: CSV, DXF, File geodatabase, GPKG, Shapefile, WFS, WMS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the files (CSV, DXF, geodatabase, GeoPackage, shapefile and WFS) were not opened, so the attribute fields and map date are unconfirmed; the map is an indicative planning tool and the portal states the hazard levels follow federal guidance. Simulation uses: hazard layers for exposure and vulnerability analysis of buildings and networks, land-use planning and flood, landslide and debris-flow risk models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
